problem:
Consider the set of matrices ${A,B},$ where 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ -1 & 3\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 \\ -3 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

If the set is linearly dependent, find the value of $\frac{{x}_{1}}{{x}_{2}}$ from a non-zero solution of ${x}_{1}A+{x}_{2}B=O,$ where $O$ is the $2\times 2$ zero-matrix.

activity_context.topic_title: Linear Independence in Abstract Vector Spaces
